problem_title: Can't invoke @InvocableMethod via the REST API
caption:
Can't invoke @InvocableMethod via the REST API

🔴 The Problem: I've been trying to use the new Spring '15 functionality related to Invocable Actions / @InvocableMethod / @InvocableVariable using the current documentation: https://www.salesforce.com/us/developer/docs/api_rest/ http://releasenotes.docs.salesforce.com/spring15/spring15/release-notes/rn_forcecom_flow_apex.htm...

✅ The Fix: ... and here it is the way to do it: To be able to execute the @InvocableMethod that is in the class, this method needs to have the one permitted parameter. If the method is defined without the parameter then this is not executed, since the REST API doesn't have enough information to know what needs to be executed / invoked.
